## Lambdas

Concise implementations of SAM interfaces. Capture effectively-final locals.

## Method references

`Class::method`, `instance::method`, and `Class::new` are shorthand for lambdas that just call one method.

## Standard functional types

`Function<T,R>`, `Predicate<T>`, `Consumer<T>`, `Supplier<T>`, `BiFunction` live in `java.util.function` and power the Streams API.
